  local x, y = tostring(a), tostring(b)
  if x == 'wood' and y == 'wood' then return 'plank' end
  if x == 'plank' and y == 'plank' then return 'table' end
  if (x == 'iron' and y == 'coal') or (x == 'coal' and y == 'iron') then return 'steel' end
  if (x == 'wood' and y == 'coal') or (x == 'coal' and y == 'wood') then return 'torch' end
  return 'none'
end)
report('craft_result slot defined')"}

name: execute_lua
arguments:
{"code":"local floor=math.floor
local function resolve(attacker,defender,skill)
local atk=attacker.atk
local alvl=attacker.level
local crit_chance=attacker.crit_chance or 0
local crit_mult=attacker.crit_mult or 150
local pen_pct=attacker.pen_pct or 0
local pen_flat=attacker.pen_flat or 0
local hp=defender.hp
local start_hp=hp
local shield=defender.shield or 0
local armor=defender.armor
local dlvl=defender.level
local delem=defender.element
local resist=defender.resist or {}
local guarding=defender.guarding or false
local power=skill.power
local selem=skill.element or 'physical'
local hits=skill.hits or 1
local true_damage=skill.true_damage or false
local seed=skill.seed or 0
local m
if selem=='physical' then
if delem=='ghost' then m=0 else m=100 end
elseif delem=='neutral' or delem=='ghost' then m=100
elseif selem=='fire' then
if delem=='nature' then m=200 else m=50 end
elseif selem=='water' then
if delem=='fire' then m=200 else m=50 end
else
if delem=='water' then m=200 else m=50 end
end
local absorbed=0
local crits=0
local resolved=0
local overkill=0
local killed=false
for k=1,hits do
local p=power-20*(k-1)
if p<10 then p=10 end
local d=floor(atk*p/100)
local diff=alvl-dlvl
if diff<-10 then diff=-10 elseif diff>10 then diff=10 end
d=floor(d*(100+3*diff)/100)
local is_crit=(seed+17*k)%100<crit_chance
if is_crit then
crits=crits+1
d=floor(d*crit_mult/100)
end
if not true_damage then
local pen=pen_pct
if is_crit then pen=pen*2 end
if pen>100 then pen=100 end
local ea=floor(armor*(100-pen)/100)-pen_flat
if ea<0 then ea=0 end
d=floor(d*100/(100+ea))
end
local immune=false
if not true_damage then
d=floor(d*m/100)
local r=resist[selem] or 0
if r<-50 then r=-50 elseif r>80 then r=80 end
d=floor(d*(100-r)/100)
if m==0 then immune=true end
end
if guarding then d=floor(d/2) end
if d<1 then
if immune then d=0 else d=1 end
end
local a=shield
if d<a then a=d end
shield=shield-a
local loss=d-a
if a>0 and shield==0 then loss=floor(loss*125/100) end
absorbed=absorbed+a
resolved=resolved+1
if loss>=hp then
overkill=loss-hp
hp=0
killed=true
break
else
hp=hp-loss
end
end
return {damage=start_hp-hp,absorbed=absorbed,hp=hp,shield=shield,overkill=overkill,crits=crits,hits=resolved,killed=killed}
end
local function ser(t)
return 'dmg='..t.damage..' abs='..t.absorbed..' hp='..t.hp..' sh='..t.shield..' ok='..t.overkill..' crits='..t.crits..' hits='..t.hits..' killed='..tostring(t.killed)
end
local r1=resolve({atk=40,level=12,crit_chance=30,crit_mult=150,pen_pct=25,pen_flat=5},{hp=60,shield=10,armor=40,level=10,element='nature',resist={fire=20},guarding=false},{power=120,element='fire',hits=2,true_damage=false,seed=3})
local r2=resolve({atk=90,level=3,crit_chance=50,crit_mult=200,pen_pct=40,pen_flat=10},{hp=300,shield=25,armor=60,level=20,element='fire',resist={water=-30},guarding=true},{power=100,element='water',hits=3,true_damage=false,seed=40})
local def=logic_define('resolve_attack',resolve)
return ser(r1)..'||'..ser(r2)..'||def='..tostring(def)"}
